name: @tweenjs/tween.js
description: Simple and fast tweening engine with optimised Robert Penner's equations.

scripts.build: bun run scripts/write-version.ts && bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --message 'v%s' && npm publish && bun run _release:push-branch
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --message 'v%s' && npm publish && bun run _release:push-branch
scripts.release:major: npm version major --message 'v%s' && npm publish && bun run _release:push-branch

author: tween.js contributors (https://github.com/tweenjs/tween.js/graphs/contributors)
